## History

P5-free and P5-saturated (re-verified from graph6). A 7-vertex double-star component plus a disjoint edge; degree sequence \[4,3,1,1,1,1,1,1,1\]. Realizes sat(9,P5)=7 after the n=7,8 plateau. Deposited 2026-07-14 as HoG #57174.
